name: Dracula
title: The King of Vampires
description:
These evening parties are not gatherings for social exchange, but hunting grounds where humans are sorted and selected.
Most are gradually drained of blood to provide sustenance for her and her kin. A chosen few are given some of Dracula's own blood and transformed into her servants.

Despite being an immortal ruler of the night, she fears her weakness to sunlight. And so she has been moving from one lair to the next before her secrets could get exposed.

localization.name: Blade of Night
localization.description:
1000% damage to 1 enemy.

When this attack hits a target and that target has 1HP remaining after damage, that target has their Active Skills disabled for 30TU. When a unit's Active Skills are disabled and they get the turn, they will lose the turn as if they were sleeping. This effect cannot affect boss units, cannot be purified, and will end if the user is defeated.

localization.name: Bloodthirsty Swarm
localization.description:
Each enemy on the battlefield has a 50% chance to have their Instant Death Wards and Stealth status effects (including Super Stealth) removed.

Then if any enemy on the battlefield still has an Instant Death Ward or Stealth, a random non-boss, non-Ephemeral enemy on the battlefield will be immediately defeated (the user is considered to have defeated that enemy with an attack). This secondary effect ignores Revenge passive skills, Revival passive skills, and any passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the random enemy from being defeated.

Locked for 50TU after the user has entered the battlefield, and locks again for 50TU after each use. Usable 5 times per battle.
localization.selected: May Remove Instant Death Wards & Stealth

localization.name: Bound in Blood
localization.description:
400% damage to all enemies, plus 150% for each time the user has already used this skill or Blade of Night while on the battlefield (max of 1000% total damage after the user has used this skill or Blade of Night 4 or more times).

Then for each enemy that was hit by this attack, there is a 20% chance, plus 20% chance per Awakening (up to 100% chance if the user has 4 Awakenings) for 1 random ally to be given next turn by reducing their current TU, and for any enemy effects that are currently disabling their Active Skills to end. Multiple triggers may target the same ally. Active skills that grant turns cannot be used by any affected allies until after they have had the turn, this skill can be used on such turns.

This skill becomes locked for 50TU after use.

localization.name: Vampiric Revelry
localization.description:
Heals all allies on the battlefield for 500% of the user's attack, Enrages them, then grants each of them a Frostburn Ward, and Stun Ward. This will overwrite the effects of other Enrage skills on those units.

The user's next attack to hit while on the battlefield ignores effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the target(s) from being defeated.

Unlocked each time the user uses all 3 of their other active skills. This skill is locked again after each use or if the user leaves the battlefield.

Enraged units have their Attack increased to 1.5x until the end of their next turn. Each Ward prevents their named effect from being applied once, then is removed. Identical Wards cannot stack.

localization.name: King of Vampires
localization.description:
This unit has 50% damage reduction from attacks.

This unit cannot be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield.

This unit cannot be immediately defeated without damage by a non-boss enemy, and cannot be defeated by damage from Poison status effects.

This unit's attacks heal this unit for 100% of total damage dealt, ignore damage reduction effects, Counter Stance Status Effects, and the effects of Skin passive skills.

Whenever another unit (ally or enemy) on the battlefield damages any unit(s) with an attack, this unit's current TU is reduced by 30TU per unit hit. When this unit gets the turn, unless this unit is sleeping or has its Active Skills disabled, this effect cannot trigger until 30TU advances.

localization.name: Immortal Blood
localization.description:
If this unit would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP.

This unit enters battle with a Frostburn Ward, and Stun Ward. After entering the battlefield, this unit heals for 100% of max HP at the start of every turn (ally or enemy) for 100TU.

This unit is Fortified, and will immediately get the turn by having its TU reduced to 0. These effects are all triggered whenever this unit enters the battlefield from reinforcements.

While this unit is on the battlefield, the first time another non-conjured unit on the battlefield is defeated or sacrificed by any source, so long as this unit is not defeated or sacrificed at the same time:
- this unit will be Purified (any negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed).
- add another Dracula to the next in line of allied reinforcements. This Dracula's Level, Limit Breaks, Awakenings, Boosts, Potential, Mastery, Weapon and Accessory will match this unit.

A Fortified unit has 50% damage reduction from attacks. This reduction cannot be ignored by attacks that do not specifically ignore Fortify. Fortify will be removed after reducing damage 3 times since applying, and will be reset if reapplied. This is not a status effect.

localization.name: HP Up Lv3
localization.description: Adds 1200 to this unit's max HP.

localization.name: Light Resist Lv3
localization.description: 10% less damage from attacks by Light units.

localization.name: Mace Mastery
localization.description: Can use weapon skills of Maces in addition to their original preferred weapon type.
